none: PAS FindID 972235: Roman Coin: Nummus of the House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Valentinian (364-378), Victory left, Reece period 19. A little less than one half of a small flan is lost; possibly irregular issue. Obverse description: Bust possibly right. Obverse inscription: possibly [---]NS AVG. Reverse description: Victory advancing left. Reverse inscription: [SECVRITAS REI] PVBLICAE. Diameter: 12.5mm, Weight: 0.95gms, die axis: possibly 6
